method: MODE (checkpoint | close) x ARRIVAL (explicit | implicit | contextual) x WORK (landed | half-done). end absorbed update on 2026-10-25, so the checkpoint phrasings are positives here. The update corpus existed because the bare noun 'checkpoint' fired on a request to READ a checkpoint (2026-08-19): its read-intent and meta negatives come over with it. Other negatives are the doors that read (start, status), report (week), and close a plan (ship runs plan close).
